transport_boundary: The release defines the standard extended all-plan infimum and root, proves probability-plan normalization and actual posterior coupling upper bounds. It is not merely a selected-coupling cost. Full general metric axioms and optimality are separate.
numerical_boundary: The residual-only mathematical stopping implication is checked, not floating-point arithmetic, an eigenvalue algorithm, or solver termination.
refinement_boundary: Grouping/re-accounting for a fixed residual preserves total energy. It is not a proof of model improvement or algorithm termination.
